topic: Day 6 — carousel — The life you're building is made of the standards you don't compromise on, not the goals you write down

slides.text: Your standards do, the ones you never compromise on.
Two people can share a goal and land nowhere close.
The gap was never ambition. It was the daily standard.

caption:
Two people can share the exact same goal and land in completely different places. The difference was never ambition, it was the standard for an ordinary day.

Follow for one of these a day.
